comment: The `- meta.yaml-doc.python` clause stops the injection from re-entering inside its own block.

patterns.comment: The first line that is only `---` (the same test plasma.util.config uses to read docstring YAML) opens the block, and the rule lasts until the string closes so no later `---` line can open another. Ending at any line holding triple quotes keeps an unclosed block from swallowing the rest of the file: the string's own end is never checked while this rule is open.
patterns.name: meta.yaml-doc.python

patterns.comment: `\G` only matches right after the opening delimiter, so this runs once: YAML until the next `---`-only line, or until the string closes if there is none.
